name: Limitless Edge
description: Cut with an edge of force whose bite deepens the longer the stroke is drawn.

name: Ceaseless Aegis
description: Hold an aegis that gathers the force of every blow into its own renewal.

name: Boundless Draw
description: Draw on a store of qi that keeps replenishing and lend its flow to the user and near allies.

name: Unfurling Reach
description: Unfurl a line of force that keeps growing across the distance and bites at its end.

name: Perpetuity Strike
description: Strike a mark so that the wound keeps deepening of its own accord after contact.

name: Endless Counter
description: Return a blow with the whole weight of every blow it has ever been answered by.

name: Infinity Step
description: Flash along a line with no end and step out of it at any point the user chooses.

name: Inexhaustible Fount
description: Open a fount of restoring qi that is fed by the healing it does and never runs low.

name: Infinite Increase
description: The school's increase in which every strike raises the force of the next without a ceiling in the user's reach.

name: Boundless Ledger
description: The school's ledger in which the user counts every effort and draws on the full sum of it at once.

name: Unfathomed Depth
description: The school's depth in which a guard opens into a space no blow can fill or find the bottom of.

name: Unceasing Ruination
description: Start a ruin that grows past its first cause up to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Unfinished Blow
description: Begin a blow whose last instant never arrives so its force keeps coming within the three-level bound; a consequence event.

name: Reach Without End
description: Cast a reach with no far end that finds the target wherever it hides within that bound; a consequence event.

name: Everrising Lance
description: Thrust a lance whose point rises in power through each hand's breadth of the guard it passes.

name: Perpetual Cascade
description: Cascade strikes in a widening ring that renews itself with every ring passed.

name: Unplumbed Aegis
description: Hold an aegis so deep that a blow falls into it and never reaches the user.

name: Eternal Restoration
description: Pour a restoring stream into a wound that keeps pace with it however deep it runs.

name: Limitless Revival
description: Pour a stream of qi into a heart just stopped and keep it beating with a flow that does not fail.

name: Endless Phase
description: Pass through a guard and a second guard behind it and a third in an unbroken slide.

name: Infinite Drain
description: Take the force of an attack into a reservoir that never fills and use it as the user's own.

name: Ceaseless Execution
description: Strike a mark with a wound that goes on deepening for as long as the user wills.

name: Infinite Progression
description: The school's progression in which each step of a sequence is greater than the last and none is the last.

name: Perpetual Genesis
description: The school's genesis that starts a flow of restoring qi renewing itself from its own ending.

name: Unending Dominion
description: The school's dominion in which the user holds a space and its contents under a rule that never lapses.

name: Infinite Cataclysm
description: Raise a cataclysm that feeds on its own spread up to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Aeonic Ruin
description: Bring down a ruin whose wounds persist through ages up to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Eternal Return
description: Make an act that has just ended begin again from its first instant within the three-level bound; a consequence event.

name: Infinity Entire
description: Hold every instance of one act at once and release them upon one target within the three-level bound; a consequence event.
